_comment: Row 354. Run from a detached scratch repository with: venv/bin/python toolchain/bin/bd-mutate --spec tests/mutants/row354_capture_graph_pin_states.json --work DETACHED_SCRATCH --timeout 300. The battery removes each independent state discriminator, exact-tree deploy record, verdict label, and mismatch-hash diagnostic. Its sibling row354_capture_graph_pin_states_transform_control.json applies the identical graph-exit-4 transform to an import-only test and must ESCAPE.
subject: Row 354 -- capture distinguishes matching, differing, and deployment-inapplicable graph pins

mutants.label: M1 an absent pin is collapsed back into hard graph failure
mutants.old:
if [ ! -f "$graph_pin" ]; then
    echo "graph pin applicability: UNKNOWN / NOT-APPLICABLE -- pin is absent: $graph_pin"
    return "$graph_not_applicable_exit"
  fi
mutants.new:
if [ ! -f "$graph_pin" ]; then
    echo "graph pin applicability: FAIL -- pin is absent: $graph_pin"
    return 1
  fi

mutants.label: M2 capture ignores that the deploy record belongs to another tree
M3 final verdict no longer identifies graph exit 1 as pin drift
M4 final verdict collapses graph not-applicable back into generic failure
M5 matching graph state disappears from the PASS verdict line
mutants.old:
if graph_state is not None:
        counts.append(f"graph pin={graph_state}")
mutants.new:
if False and graph_state is not None:
        counts.append(f"graph pin={graph_state}")

mutants.label: M6 deploy records the commit object instead of the exact deployed tree
mutants.old:
printf '%s\n' "$DEPLOY_TREE" > "$GTMP" \
  || die "could not prepare deployed tree provenance"
mutants.new:
printf '%s\n' "$NEW" > "$GTMP" \
  || die "could not prepare deployed tree provenance"

mutants.label: M7 loud graph mismatch hides the deployed pin hash
mutants.old: f"{want[:16]}... (graph content changed; re-pin with --write-hash if intended)")
mutants.new: f"<hidden> (graph content changed; re-pin with --write-hash if intended)")

mutants.label: M8 fresh-host provisioning writes the tree record under a path capture never reads
